claims.claim: A study of twelve uncertainty estimation methods on eight general LLMs over four NLP tasks and seven programming-capable LLMs on two code tasks (MBPP, HumanEval) finds uncertainty estimation can characterize prediction risks.
claims.stance_target: L1: early multi-method UQ comparison on code, scored with CodeBLEU-derived correctness
claims.scope_conditions: CodeQwen1.5, DeepSeek Coder 6.7B, StarCoder2 7B, Code Llama 7B; MBPP 500, HumanEval 164
claims.quoted_support: Abstract: twelve uncertainty estimation methods and eight general LLMs on four NLP tasks and seven programming-capable LLMs on two code generation tasks

breadth.model_families_and_sizes: LLaMA2, LLaMA3 8B, Gemma2 9B, Phi3, CodeQwen1.5 7B, DeepSeek Coder 6.7B, StarCoder2 7B, Code Llama (Table II)
